title: holodiscus fissus
intro: Holodiscus fissus, commonly known as Scouler's rose or rough rosy princess, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. It has been used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is often used to treat wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infection, and promote wound healing through its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Holodiscus fissus contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
